'''Kolas''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] who resided in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Farpoint]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Fhost]]. He was a regular on the [[Black Hole (Fhost)|Black Hole]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] and often engaged [[Khedryn Faal]]&mdash;a salvage jockey&mdash;in friendly banter.<ref name="Crosscurrent" />
